$comment: Rules for the automatic upstream updates (.github/workflows/updates.yml, Harbor decision 175). Every field is optional: apps.<id>.skip (a reason; the bot leaves the app alone), hold (services that never move), match (service -> regular expression the new tag must match), note (for people). defaults.minAgeDays: how old a release must be before the bot takes it (default 2).

immich.note: Immich names the exact Postgres (VectorChord) image each release needs in its own docker-compose.yml; move it by hand with the release notes open.

karakeep.note: Karakeep names the Meilisearch version it supports in its own docker/docker-compose.yml; move it by hand when that file does. The package sets MEILI_EXPERIMENTAL_DUMPLESS_UPGRADE: a newer Meilisearch upgrades the index in place and an older one can no longer open it, so a rolled-back update leaves Meilisearch unable to start until its volume is emptied and Karakeep reindexes. Chrome majors arrive as pull requests: the smoke run only checks that DevTools answers.

qbittorrent.note: The after-start hook depends on the linuxserver layout (/run/service/svc-qbittorrent, /config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf, python3, curl) and on WebUI\HostHeaderValidation and WebUI\Password_PBKDF2. It checks its own result and stops qBittorrent when it fails, so a move that breaks it fails the smoke test; read the [Harbor after-start hook] line in the container log first.

romm.note: RomM minors can carry long one-way migrations (5.4.0: 15-20 min on big libraries), longer than Harbor 600 s readiness ceiling; a rollback mid-migration leaves a half-migrated database. Move minors by hand after reading the release notes.

kavita.note: compose.yaml passes [-c, script] to the image ENTRYPOINT [/bin/bash], which then execs /entrypoint.sh, to write appsettings.Production.json (KnownProxies). Before merging a move, check the release Dockerfile still has ENTRYPOINT /bin/bash and /entrypoint.sh; otherwise the script is silently skipped and EPUB pictures break on the secure LAN address, while the smoke still passes.
